title: test: the fake SMTP sink takes a port; pin the activation door's metadata-plane 503 and the approver-bound dead-link pages

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4Jsmd91BqTVB7dSii9uJMV)_

Fixes #33352

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只动测试与测试工具。① plugin-email 的假 SMTP 收件器 `startFakeSmtp` 新增 `port` 选项（默认 0 = 系统随机端口，原行为不变；端口被占用时直接报 `EADDRINUSE`，不会悄悄换端口）；② 给「动作启停门」补一个单元钉子：元数据平面故障时答 503 而不是 404，且不写启停行；③ 给审批一键链接补一个钉子：已处理（not_pending）和已转交（not_approver）的链接页面带请求摘要、不改任何状态，且转交走的审批人拿不到新链接。
- 为什么改：v18.4.0 测试清单收尾时有 8 处「任何真实入口都够不到」的分支（#33352）。逐行判断：除 SMTP 端口外都不加测试门（不加生产配置能打开的门），改为指明已有单元钉子；其中两处连单元钉子都没有，本 PR 补上。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险——不改任何发布代码（testkit 不在发布包里，已构建后核对 `dist/` 无该符号）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/fake-smtp.testkit.ts`（port 选项与监听报错）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts`（新 503 钉子）；`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts`（新页面钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/transports/smtp.wire.test.ts`，应见 `Tests  23 passed (23)`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #33352 lists eight checklist arms no real door reaches. Each row ends with a door or a `unit-pinned:` line. The per-row table is in the card comment. This PR carries the code half:

- **Row 14 — `startFakeSmtp` takes a port.** `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/fake-smtp.testkit.ts` gains `StartFakeSmtpOptions.port`. The default stays `0`, an OS-picked ephemeral port, so every in-tree caller (`smtp.wire.test.ts`, `sys-email-payload.wire.test.ts`) is unchanged. A runner that reserves a port range per run can now pass a port from its own range, so its sink cannot land in a range another runner reserved. A port already held rejects with the listen error (`EADDRINUSE`); before this change, `listen` had no error handler. A port outside 0 to `SMTP_PORT_MAX` is refused with a `RangeError`. The ceiling comes from `smtp-port-contract.ts`, because `smtp-port-contract.test.ts` refuses a second literal. The checklist runner drivers are the parallel callers that need the option. Their fixture text (`identity-auth.email-verification-loop`, `identity-auth.self-service-password-reset`) is devx's to update, and the card comment gives the wording.
- **Row 77 — the activation door's metadata-plane 503 had no pin.** `action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts` adds 'a metadata plane that cannot answer is 503, not the 404 a miss gets, and writes no row'. The `boot()` harness takes `metadataDegraded`, which is the dispatch-door test's spelling. The case asserts 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, the loader error in the message, and `setActionActive` never entered.
- **Row 73 — the approver-bound dead-link pages had no page-level pin.** `action-page-member.integration.test.ts` adds 'a link whose slot moved on — decided, or handed to someone else — is told WITH the request summary, and moves nothing'. Through GET and POST, the `not_pending` and `not_approver` pages are compared byte for byte with `renderResultPage(kind, request)`, and they are not the summary-less page. The decided request keeps one decision, and the reassigned one stays pending with none. The same case presents an approver whose slot moved on to `issueActionTokens` and gets `FORBIDDEN`, with the new holder as the control. That is the half of `approvals.email-action-token-door` acceptance[0] that only had the 'stranger' arm before.

No door is added for rows 73, 74, 76, 77, 78 or 191: each door would be a production-reachable credential mint, tenant-wall bypass or fault injector. Row 234's door already exists: `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES=1`.

## Tests

Final head `451e44f25` unless noted.

<details><summary>New and touched pins (vitest, under os-verify-lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole package, at `42ce2a539`, the last commit touching the package): `Test Files  53 passed (53)` · `Tests  1042 passed (1042)`. The first full run had found the ceiling-literal red in `smtp-port-contract.test.ts`, which `42ce2a539` fixed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts` (at `dba662b0c`, the last commit touching the package): `Tests  30 passed (30)`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts`: `Tests  13 passed (13)`. The whole package ran at `42ce2a539`, before the final commit added the FORBIDDEN assertion to this file: `Test Files  120 passed (120)` · `Tests  1652 passed (1652)`.
- typecheck, `tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`: plugin-email OK (0 ledger entries) · plugin-approvals OK (at `451e44f25`) · runtime OK (at `dba662b0c`, after building `@objectstack/driver-turso`, whose missing `dist` had red-flagged an untouched file).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `domains/actions.ts`: `if (declaration.degraded) {` changed to `if (false && declaration.degraded) {`. The new 503 case goes red, `expected 404 to be 503`, 1 failed / 29 passed.
- `approval-service.ts`: the GET page lost its request (`renderResultPage(peek.reason)`). The new page case goes red at `not_pending GET`, 1 failed / 12 passed.
- `approval-service.ts`: `issueActionTokens`' pending check became `if (false && …)`. The new case goes red, `promise resolved … instead of rejecting`.
- `fake-smtp.testkit.ts`: `server.listen(requestedPort,` changed to `server.listen(0,`. The two port cases go red, `expected 42037 to be 46159` and `promise resolved … instead of rejecting`, 2 failed / 21 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Existing pins cited by the card comment (all green)</summary>

plugin-approvals `approval-service.test.ts` + `sys-approval-token-generic-door.integration.test.ts` + `reminder-action-link-at-rest.integration.test.ts` + `approval-token-internal-hash.integration.test.ts`: 492/492 · runtime `automation-activation-posture-gate.test.ts`: 19/19 · service-storage `attachment-lifecycle.test.ts` + `storage-routes.test.ts` + `attachment-read-leaf.test.ts` + `attachment-read-leaf.integration.test.ts`: 184/184 · mcp `mcp-action-tools.test.ts`: 25/25 · service-automation `run-dropped-fields.test.ts`: 18/18 · verify `action-flow-dropped-fields.test.ts`: 2/2.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Publishing: nothing this PR changes ships. `files[]` of `@objectstack/plugin-email` is `dist`, README and CHANGELOG. After a build, `startFakeSmtp` and `StartFakeSmtpOptions` have zero hits in `dist/`, and the `SmtpTransport` control is found in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`. The other three files are test files. So this PR takes `skip-changeset`, which the dispatching seat applies.
- Four halves of `approvals.email-action-token-door` still have no pin, and none of them has a safe door: the byte-identity of the actions timeline and `consumed_at` across GETs (acceptance[1]), a failed decide that still burns its token (acceptance[3]), the action token presented as a bearer on an authenticated route (acceptance[5]), and the email-rendering leg. These are coverage gaps, not defects.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 55 commands from the four changed files at merge base `e0ce1b523`. All 55 ran at `451e44f25` and exited 0; `--ran` reports `55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`. Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four files exits 0. CI runs the full farm.
